propositions: Current clarity_score rewards volume and legacy shape rather than adherence to author-guide leaf/container contracts, allowing padded tickets to pass without required sections.
The deterministic clarity measure is duplicated in gates.py and det_floor.py, creating maintenance drift and preventing consistent extension of checks.

Seven mechanically testable criteria can be added without semantic judgment: required-section shape by graph altitude, AC verification coverage with proof markers, placeholder-free Scope/Approach, grounded edit-sets with file_impact structure, AC text hygiene, Testing shape when declared, and nonempty Context/Problem.

Author-guide documentation conflicts with authoritative criteria guidance on Success Criteria versus Acceptance Criteria and on required rejected-alternative wording, requiring alignment before clarity encoding.
